# The Game Corner (seed 27): the two warnings, then three plays. Each play
# draws Random(10) 10,000 times and the last draw counts: 2, 8, 8
# (simulated). Bet 1050 on 2 for POKéBalls (10 balls and 50 × 10¥), 1050 on
# 3 (lost), then 300 on 8 for money (×10).
Money 5000
party 25 10
> start
> seed 27
> menu Actions > Game Corner

> type FormB.SpinEdit1 1050
